en-US.title: OpenPlayer - Native Plugin Permission
en-US.warning: This plugin will run native software with your account's file and network access. It is NOT sandboxed. Only continue if you trust the entire plugin package.
en-US.video: This module may also load its declared video runtime into OpenPlayer and process playback frames. A runtime failure can crash the player. The runtime remains loaded until you exit OpenPlayer.

zh-CN.title: OpenPlayer - 原生插件授权
zh-CN.warning: 此插件将以当前用户权限运行原生程序，可以访问文件和网络，不受插件沙箱限制。请仅在信任整个插件包时继续。
zh-CN.video: 此模块还可将声明的视频运行时加载到 OpenPlayer 进程并处理播放画面。运行时故障可能导致播放器崩溃，加载后将驻留至播放器退出。
